## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, what "fuzzy"
means, and how labels are normalised. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 4b specifics

- Book 4b is vol. 4, part 2: ဥဒ – ဥဠုရာဇ (uda – uḷurāja). 681 PDF pages, 631 indexed.
- **The best volume so far**: 96.6% of articles located and 90.8% with label + body, against
  92.1–94.7% and 85.0–89.6% for vols. 1–4/1. It is set in a cleaner typeface.
- **The index spells ဉာ where this book prints ညာ** (ဥဒယဗ္ဗယဉာဏ… in the index, ဥဒယဗ္ဗယညာဏ… on
  p. 74). Of the 30 index headwords with ဉာ, recall misses 9, and 6 of those are in the text as ညာ.
  In vols. 1–4/1 the same test finds 1 of 15 misses. So this is the print's spelling in 4b, not
  an OCR error. The same holds for ါ/ာ after a stacked consonant (ဥပသမ္ပါဒေ… / ဥပသမ္ပာဒေ…, p. 416),
  as in vol. 3.
- **An index typo**: ဥဒယဗ္ဗကဉာကပဋိပါဋိ (p. 74) is printed ဥဒယဗ္ဗယညာဏပဋိပါဋိ. The fuzzy match
  places it right; the index headword is kept as it is.
- **Labels with a lost bracket** — "(ကြို [" — were common here: reading them gained 314 labels
  (label + body 86.1% → 90.8%); 299 of the 312 the typed witness has agree with it.

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `4b.pdf` at 72 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 300 | an ordinary page | 11 | 11 | 0 | 0 | 11 right |
| 74 | the worst page (0 of 7 read) | 7 | 7 | 0 | 0 | 7 right |
| 416 | a run of weak pages (7 of 17) | 17 | 15 | 0 | 2 | 13 right, 1 not read (1 entry has none) |

No article on the three pages is placed at a wrong entry, and no label is wrong.

- **P. 300**: all 11 at their own entry. Four of the labels were read only after the lost-bracket
  fix: (ထီ၊န) read "(ထံ၊န)", (ကမ္မ၊ကြိ) read "(ကမ္ပ ကြိ)", and two "(ကြို [".
- **P. 74**: recall 0, placements 7 of 7. Every headword has ဉာ in the index and ညာ in print.
- **P. 416**: ဥပသမ္ဖုသတိ and ဥပသမ္ဖုသေ are unlocated (the stacked ဖ misread); their text is in
  the article before them. ဥပသဝန္တိ, printed without a label, starts on the third line of its own
  article, at a quotation, because its head was misread. ဥပသာဂရ's (ပု) was read "(၃)", which the
  map does not take.
